title: Model Maps: A Documentation Framework for Tracing Foundation Model Ancestry and Understanding AI Entanglement
abstract: arXiv:2611.18998v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The development of foundation models incorporates pre-existing AI artifacts like models, datasets, and benchmarks. These relationships, as part of the broader AI supply chain, produce "entangled" webs in which properties of artifacts upstream can influence the outputs of a foundation model downstream - a phenomenon known as AI entanglement. Without visibility into these connections, a black-box model can inherit upstream properties that result in security vulnerabilities, hallucinations, or biased predictions, yet developers are left with no recourse to identify or mitigate the root issue. To address these concerns, we introduce model maps as a conceptual documentation framework for tracing model ancestry that builds on previous documentation frameworks like ecosystem graphs, datasheets, and model cards. translated_title: 模型图谱：一种用于追踪基础模型谱系和理解人工智能纠缠的文档框架
translated_abstract: 基础模型的开发融合了已有的AI产物，如模型、数据集和基准测试。这些关系作为更广泛的AI供应链的一部分，形成了“纠缠”网络，其中上游产物的属性可能会影响下游基础模型的输出——这种现象被称为AI纠缠。由于缺乏对这些关联的可见性，黑盒模型可能会继承导致安全漏洞、幻觉或偏见预测的上游属性，而开发者却无从识别或缓解根本问题。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了模型图谱作为一种概念性文档框架，用于追踪模型谱系，该框架建立在生态系统图谱、数据表和模型卡等先前的文档框架基础之上。给定基础模型的模型图谱是一个详细的知识图谱，用于表示影响该模型开发的各产物之间的关系。
tldr: 该论文提出了“模型图谱”这一概念性文档框架，通过构建详细的知识图谱来追踪基础模型的谱系关系，帮助开发者透视AI供应链中的“AI纠缠”现象，从而识别并缓解黑盒模型因继承上游产物属性而产生的安全漏洞、幻觉或偏见等根本问题。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Model Maps, a conceptual documentation framework that traces foundation model ancestry through detailed knowledge graphs, providing visibility into AI entanglement within the AI supply chain so developers can identify and mitigate root causes of inherited security vulnerabilities, hallucinations, or biased predictions in black-box models.
